app.name: VERIFLOW
tab.offload.desc: Secure copy of camera and sound rolls to one or more destinations, with checksum verification and ASC MHL report.
tab.media.desc: Browse, preview and edit media metadata.
tab.player.desc: Frame-accurate playback, logs and markers, sent to reports.
tab.sync.desc: Batch sync by timecode, LTC or waveform.
tab.transcode.desc: Convert to any codec and container, presets and queue.
tab.report.desc: Sound, camera and EDL reports, editable and exportable.
